title: Substring Match Filter Condition and Local Text Matching Correctness
mini_srs: This milestone introduces the match: { substring } filter condition in the qdrant contract API (gRPC Match.substring = 12 in qdrant_common.proto) and corrects text matching semantics in the qdrant-client local mode. The contract change (bedab3c) adds unindexed text substring matching as a new filter condition served by the keyword index key dictionary or by scanning payload values. The local mode fix (de3c432) aligns MatchText and MatchPhrase with the server's token-aware whole-word matching instead of raw substring scanning and corrects IsNull semantics for arrays containing null elements. The follow-up (6a6fd05) extends token-aware matching to MatchTextAny so that it checks whole document tokens rather than substrings. The v1.19 sync commit (589aece) bridges the contract by bringing the substring model field into qdrant-client. Tested via unit tests in test_payload_filters.py and CI congruence tests comparing local and server behavior.
expansion_rationale: bedab3c adds Match.substring (qdrant_common.proto line 127-128 and conversions.rs lines 2282-2284). Hard xrepo edge bedab3c->de3c432 (conf 0.75) confirmed: de3c432 patch (payload_filters.py) rewrites check_match for MatchText/MatchPhrase to use unindexed_text_tokens() and fixes IsNull for arrays (lines 248-253). 589aece is required for path completeness between bedab3c and de3c432 (DAG path bedab3c->589aece->de3c432 via intra-repo edge 589aece->de3c432 in payload_filters.py). 6a6fd05 (de3c432 descendant via payload_filters.py edge) converts MatchTextAny from substring scan to token-aware matching (PR #1419).

title: Per-Element Nested Payload Indexes
mini_srs: This milestone adds per-element (nested) payload indexes to the qdrant API layer. The primary commit (fb0cda7) introduces a new nested parameter on all eight payload index param types (keyword integer float geo text bool datetime uuid) in both REST and gRPC APIs enabling indexing of each array element as a separate entry with its own element map. The API changes span conversions.rs (8 From impls and 8 TryFrom impls updated) collections.proto (8 index param messages extended) qdrant.rs (8 struct definitions gain a nested field) and validate.rs (destructured fields updated). The follow-on (5bc3720) extends the null index to also operate per-element so that is_empty on a nested field matches a point when one of its elements lacks the field. Both commits are by the same author (generall) committed on Oct 21 2026.
expansion_rationale: fb0cda7 patch shows nested field added to every *IndexParams message in collections.proto (e.g. KeywordIndexParams line 719-721 IntegerIndexParams line 748-750) and every conversion impl in conversions.rs. 5bc3720 is the sole descendant (DAG edge fb0cda7->5bc3720 via collections.proto and qdrant.rs) updating is_empty doc strings from 'Default: disabled' to include the per-element semantics. Both are cherry-picked from dev (69e7678 and 5c5ff38). PR #11126 and #11207 are the qdrant PRs.

title: Sync Nested Payload Index Parameters to Rust Client
mini_srs: This commit syncs the per-element nested payload index parameters from the qdrant contract to the rust-client SDK. It adds an optional nested setter method to every IndexParamsBuilder (keyword integer float geo text bool datetime uuid) in rust-client/src/builders/ and updates the qdrant.rs struct definitions to include the new nested: Option<String> field on all index param structs. The BM25 scoring doc comment is also corrected to no longer claim it implies phrase_matching. Changes cover 9 files: 8 builder modules and qdrant.rs. PR #303.
